sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE上巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Primary Set A component for 上巻. Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for all 19 Joukan endings and B.S.S. triggers. The page explicitly identifies the covered title as the PlayStation 2 software released 2000-12-21, matching the guide target exactly.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE下巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Primary Set A component for 下巻. Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for all 27 Gekan endings, route labels, B.S.S. triggers, and BLOOD thresholds. It is the companion page to XNEO's explicitly PS2-targeted 上巻 guide and covers the original two-volume PS2 structure.
